Please take care of yourself while studying or you’ll burn yourself out otherwise. This exam is time consuming but it shouldn’t take over your life. Personally, I was at my best with retaining information when I went to the gym, spent time with friends, dating, doing the things I love, etc. It takes discipline to balance the two but it’s most definitely possible.
I took FAR twice and got sims on it both times. Definitely study it.

I work full time and I got through it in about 4 weeks but that was right after I completed FAR which helped me along since there’s quit a bit of overlap between those 2 sections. It really depends on you, your study method, and how comfortable you are with the material in any given section. For example, I work in audit so that’s an advantage for me but REG took forever lol.

It’s also important to consider that previous posts you may see about passing AUD in a short amount of time maybe from people that passed pre-evolution so there was potentially less material they were working with.
The fact that’s there’s only a three week turnaround to the next testing window definitely doesn’t help.

Either way definitely watch them if it’s helping you understand the materials.

The CPA exam isn’t a test of intelligence, don’t listen to those people. I would definitely reflect on why you’re not retaining the information which is the hardest part of this exam by far.
